name: cc-board
description: Per-session checklist (todos + manual steps you tick off) and a live board of every Claude Code session on this machine.

haikuSummary.title: Haiku summary
haikuSummary.description: When the todo list is empty, ask Haiku for a one-sentence summary of what the session is doing (at most once per five minutes).

followUps.title: Surface loose ends
followUps.description: After a turn that mentions something to do later, by hand, or not yet, ask Haiku to list those loose ends and add them to the checklist.

band.title: Sessions above the prompt
band.description: Also list the sessions in the band above the prompt, for a terminal too narrow for the pane. The pane lists them either way.

boardUrl.title: Shared board URL
boardUrl.description: The Supabase project URL whose cc_board table holds one row per session, so every machine and cloud session sees one board. Empty keeps the board local. Also read from CC_BOARD_URL.

boardKey.title: Shared board key
boardKey.description: A secret key of that project, used only to read and write cc_board. Also read from CC_BOARD_KEY.
